title: Resident population by state, District of Columbia and Puerto Rico
method: Value is the Census Bureau published POPESTIMATE{year} field, parsed as a nonnegative integer without interpolation, aggregation or denominator adjustment.
warnings: Larger jurisdictions tend to have larger populations; use comparisons rather than treating high totals as adverse outcomes.
The values are Census population estimates for July 1 of each year, not decennial enumeration counts.
County and tract values are not included in this initial release.
